name: tis-website
description: Build layer for tisglobalinc.com. The site is hand-authored static HTML served from the repo root; this builds the vendored GSAP and Lenis bundles, minified CSS/JS twins, subset fonts, WebP images, the search index and the sitemap into assets/build/.

scripts.build: vite build && npm run fonts && npm run min && npm run images && npm run search && npm run sitemap
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
